description: High-blast-radius provider and saga failure matrix for checkout -> payment -> fulfillment -> accounting -> email hardening.

providers.rollbackPosture: disable STRIPE_PROVIDER_ENABLED and PAYMENTS_STRIPE_SANDBOX_ENABLED; keep webhooks fail-closed and reconcile local payment-control state before retrying.

failureModes.trigger: Stripe webhook signature, timestamp, or raw body mismatch.
failureModes.expectedPosture: reject before persistence and do not apply payment-control business state.
failureModes.compensation: operator verifies provider event in Stripe dashboard and replays only through verified webhook/event-ingestion path.

failureModes.trigger: provider paid/local unpaid, local paid/provider unpaid, or amount/currency mismatch.
failureModes.expectedPosture: surface sanitized observability evidence without issuing fulfillment or accounting side effects.
failureModes.compensation: use payment-control recovery/reconciliation before fulfillment eligibility can advance.

providers.rollbackPosture: disable PAYMENTS_TPAY_ENABLED/PAYMENTS_TPAY_SANDBOX_ENABLED and keep simulator-only flows until signed sandbox evidence is restored.

failureModes.trigger: Tpay notification has invalid JWS signature, certificate origin, or mutable raw payload.
failureModes.expectedPosture: reject before provider event persistence and exclude bearer/JWS/BLIK data from logs.
failureModes.compensation: operator replays only a valid signed notification after certificate/root-certificate posture is corrected.

failureModes.trigger: A new BLIK Model O activation is disabled, or a saved/renewal PAYID lacks explicit stored Model O consent.
failureModes.expectedPosture: fail closed before durable provider-attempt preparation and keep local subscription recovery actionable.
failureModes.compensation: enable the single Model O activation switch for a reviewed new mandate, or repair the exact subscription to a valid stored Model O/card method; never infer consent.

providers.rollbackPosture: disable COMMERCE_ACCOUNTING_MUTATIONS_ENABLED/FAKTUROWNIA_PROVIDER_ENABLED and continue shadow/test-PDF evidence only.

failureModes.trigger: invoice create/send requested without provider mode, demo posture, or accounting mutation gate.
failureModes.expectedPosture: fail closed before HTTP mutation and keep local ledger unchanged.
failureModes.compensation: operator re-enables only the missing accounting gate after demo/hidden-preview evidence is documented.

failureModes.trigger: KSeF convergence attempts a Fakturownia mutation, staging polling is requested, or a staging mutation falls outside the exact confirmed DEMO profile.
failureModes.expectedPosture: leave submission authority in the Fakturownia account, allow only the short-lived confirmed DEMO mutation rail with account-global KSeF off, and use GET-only provider reads to converge sanitized local evidence.
failureModes.compensation: disable government polling or the unconfirmed mutation posture, verify the Fakturownia account configuration, then replay the appropriate existing issue or read-only status job.

providers.rollbackPosture: disable COMMERCE_OMNIPACK_DISPATCH_ENABLED/COMMERCE_OMNIPACK_STOCK_SYNC_ENABLED and keep simulator or shadow evidence only.

failureModes.trigger: fulfillment dispatch retries or idempotency replay after local draft evidence already exists.
failureModes.expectedPosture: do not double-call provider; record replay/readback evidence and preserve local state.
failureModes.compensation: operator reviews dispatch attempt ledger and replays only idempotent handoff worker.

failureModes.trigger: provider/local stock mismatch, low-stock threshold, or webhook/reconciliation status drift.
failureModes.expectedPosture: record evidence and alerts without mutating checkout inventory or DHL state.
failureModes.compensation: disable stock-sync/webhook flags and reconcile local fulfillment state from recorded provider facts.

providers.rollbackPosture: unset DHL_LIVE_PREVIEW_CONFIRMED and keep DHL direct-carrier actions manual/operator-triggered only.

failureModes.trigger: DHL selected without credentials, account number, or explicit live-preview confirmation.
failureModes.expectedPosture: fail closed before provider call and keep fulfillment handoff pending.
failureModes.compensation: operator restores DHL env/confirmation or switches fulfillment provider back to simulator/manual.

failureModes.trigger: DHL SOAP (or, historically, the retired DHL Edge Function) returns provider fault, HTML error, or already-booked courier state.
failureModes.expectedPosture: surface sanitized operator evidence only; do not leak credentials, raw XML, or customer payloads.
failureModes.compensation: operator retries the specific DHL adapter action after checking provider state and local shipment refs.

providers.rollbackPosture: disable COMMERCE_OUTBOX_DISPATCH_ENABLED and Resend sandbox/live provider mode; keep events queued for replay.

failureModes.trigger: Resend API rejects, times out, or returns unavailable during outbox dispatch.
failureModes.expectedPosture: retry or discard according to outbox worker policy without losing the event audit trail.
failureModes.compensation: operator replays queued outbox rows after provider/sandbox mode is restored.

failureModes.trigger: hidden-preview outbox matrix cannot prove send, destination, or cleanup contract.
failureModes.expectedPosture: keep hidden-preview closeout on HOLD and do not claim platform green.
failureModes.compensation: fix matrix blocker, rerun Auto Deploy Staging, and require CLEAN post-merge closeout.
